projects.title: Arya
projects.summary: A premium Shopify store for Arya, a gold jewelry brand.
projects.problem: Arya needed a fully customized Shopify store that reflects a premium, luxury jewelry and accessories brand identity while delivering excellent performance, usability, and a strong focus on conversion rate optimization.
built: A premium store that matches the brand identity and shows the premium guarantee
Custom homepage sections and advanced product page customization with custom Liquid and Shopify metafields
Variant and color swatch improvements and product recommendations
Mobile-first responsive design, collection page enhancements and an improved cart and shopping experience
Performance optimization, SEO improvements and smooth premium animations
